data.name: Musheer
data.gender_notes: Musheer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who guides others, traveler, or a horseman. The name Musheer carries the meaning “Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Musheer usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A guide or helper on the spiritual journey
data.etymology: Musheer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musheer total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
